properties.site-address: Land at Mote Cottages, High Street, Eynsford
properties.notes: The site comprises two residential dwellings, a B2 workshop to the north and area of grassland to the south. Bounded by the High Street to the south, residential development to the west, school to the east and open countryside to the north. Mature trees line the northern and eastern boundaries of the site.
